An absolute beast with a nasty bite. Don't get too close. May cause massacres.

Category: V. Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: SMG

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 40 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: Yes (Only while unloaded), but at a -2 penalty to Conceal/Reveal Object

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load modified Armor-Piercing Ammunition (50eb [Costly] per 10 rounds), which also functions like an Explosive when interacting with Cover for the purposes of carrying damage to targets behind destroyed Cover, and deals double damage to Cover (and only Cover). When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6).

Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks
Range: SMG
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
